subject.title: Support Workers AI model selection during onboard

question: Should the bundled Cloudflare AI Gateway plugin remain a narrowly scoped Anthropic onboarding path, or should it support Workers AI/model selection as part of a broader REST and multi-provider gateway contract?
rationale: The requested onboarding behavior is coupled to unresolved choices about the plugin’s supported endpoint, authentication/header behavior, model catalog semantics, and scope; code review cannot safely select that lasting public contract.

options.title: Sponsor a unified gateway contract
options.body: Define the REST and multi-provider model contract first, then include Workers AI onboarding as a focused plugin-owned slice.

options.title: Keep the plugin Anthropic-only
options.body: Document the exact supported generic custom-provider configuration for Workers AI and close this request only after that route is intentionally accepted.

options.title: Split a narrow Workers AI mode
options.body: Approve a bounded Workers AI onboarding mode only if its endpoint, API, model-id, and compatibility contract are explicitly specified apart from the broader gateway work.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a unified gateway contract
recommendation.body: Define the REST and multi-provider model contract first, then include Workers AI onboarding as a focused plugin-owned slice.

likelyOwner.reason: The available feature-history evidence most directly connects this person to the current bundled Cloudflare provider implementation.
